articles.title: Horoscope for Wednesday, July 22, 2026
articles.description:
Moon Alert

Avoid shopping (except food and gas) and important decisions after 4 p.m. The moon is in Scorpio.

Aries (March 21-April 19)

A positive day

Plan on more socializing and participating in sports events in the next several weeks. Romance, the creative arts and fun activities with children will flourish. In fact, the next four weeks are a great time for a vacation. Make plans to enjoy yourself.

Taurus (April 20-May 20)

An average day

Today it's best to go along to get along when dealing with spouses, partners and close friends. Meanwhile, in the next four weeks, your involvement with home, family and a parent will increase. Look for ways to make your home more comfortable. Enjoy relaxing in familiar surroundings.

Gemini (May 21-June 20)

A positive day

The pace of your days will accelerate in the next four weeks because suddenly you have places to go, things to do, and people to see. Enjoy interacting with siblings, neighbors and relatives. Everyone wants to see your face!

Cancer (June 21-July 22)

An average day

Tomorrow Mercury stops being retrograde in your sign, which is a great relief. Meanwhile, you will find that your focus on money, earnings and cash flow will increase in the next four weeks. Look for ways to boost your income because this is your year to get richer.

Leo (July 23-Aug. 22)

A positive day

Today the sun enters your sign to stay for the next four weeks. (Happens once a year.) This is favorable for you! It will energize you and give you a chance to recharge your batteries for the rest of the year. Expect good fortune, especially with lucky Jupiter in your sign!

Virgo (Aug. 23-Sept. 22)

An average day

Your personal year is coming to an end, which is why the next four weeks will be a quiet time for you. It's an excellent window for you to define future goals because goals give you a clearer focus on what is important. Goals also give you a sense of purpose.

Libra (Sept. 23-Oct. 22)

A positive day

Your popularity will increase in the next four weeks. Get out and enjoy schmoozing! (You'll welcome this because you are the most social sign of the zodiac.) You might join groups as well as see friends. This is also an excellent time to define future goals.

Scorpio (Oct. 23-Nov. 21)

An average day

You'll look great to authority figures in the next four weeks because the sun is at the top of your chart. This happens once a year and symbolizes that you are thrust into a flattering spotlight. You impress everyone. This is the time to go after what you want!

Sagittarius (Nov. 22-Dec. 21)

A positive day

Grab every opportunity to travel and expand your world in the next four weeks. If you can't travel, then be a tourist in your own city. You can also expand your world through further education, books, film, and talking to people from other backgrounds.

Capricorn (Dec. 22-Jan. 19)

An average day

You can benefit or gain wealth through the resources of someone else, perhaps a partner, not only this year, but very strongly in the next four weeks. Bear this in mind and keep your pockets open!

Aquarius (Jan. 20-Feb. 18)

A positive day

For the next four weeks, you will need more sleep than usual. Accept this. Don’t fight it. Take naps or get more rest. You might also focus on partners, spouses and close friendships more than usual. It's just what's happening.

Pisces (Feb. 19-March 20)

An average day

Good news! You'll be eager to work hard in the next four weeks simply because you're motivated. This energy and drive will come out of the blue. Use it to your advantage so you can improve your job or get a better job.

If today is your birthday

Singer and actress Selena Gomez (1992) shares your birthday today. You are sensitive and caring. You're innovative, resourceful and energetic. Enjoy socializing this year because your desire for life is at a pinnacle. Nurture the happiness and beauty that you have within yourself. Let your guard down and loosen up a bit. Have fun, but remember your goals.

articles.title: Rivers of magma once bubbled beneath Mars’ crust, research suggests
articles.description: Finding widens selection of rocky planets that may once have been habitable Mars once had rivers of magma bubbling beneath its crust, new research suggests. The surprise find makes it more probable that Mars could have supported life and widens the selection of rocky planets that may once have been habitable. Researchers at the University of Oxford studied data gathered by Nasa’s Insight Lander , which recorded seismic waves caused by meteorite impacts and Martian quakes. They used the seismic data to analyse a mysterious boundary 15 miles (24km) below the surface of Mars. Their findings, published in Nature Astronomy , showed that the most likely cause for this boundary was molten rock pooling deep underground and stretching sideways for hundreds or even thousands of miles.
